auth_access_model: Public definitions may be published, but this reader needs an explicitly authorized local catalog and release with trusted independent SHA-256 pins; no acquisition, credentials or network.
data_domains: Legacy concept identity and mapping review

discovery_search.note: Local pinned catalog search and exact-IRI lookup, cross-checked against released definitions; no general ontology ranking.

metadata_schema.note: Only the reviewed schema-2.0 catalog and immutable release artifact contract.

identifier_crosswalks.note: Explicit legacy identity reuse and informational mapping status; candidate/rejected/deferred mappings never canonicalize records.

provenance_versioning.note: Independent catalog and manifest pins plus released artifact hash verification.

bulk_access_api_ergonomics.note: Bounded local JSON CLI; no remote service or automatic export retrieval.

blockers: An authorized compatible local export and trusted catalog/manifest hashes are required.
Vocabulary concepts do not resolve operational stock records or population membership.
governance_constraints: Preserve exact definitions and provisional/domain-review status.
Local read authorization does not grant disclosure or scientific acceptance.
watch_fields: Immutable release manifest and catalog hash binding
